subject: Request: Pilot runway extension due to integration backlog (Novasys)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Granger <elliot@novasys.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot runway extension due to integration backlog (Novasys)

Hi Elliot / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clear signal from your engineering team about the connector issues. I understand the adapter edge-case in your staging environment is blocking your QA pass and the demo next week.

Quick ask from our side: given the integration sprint has slipped and your team needs time to finish the SAML shim + webhook replay fixes, can we extend the pilot window by two weeks and provision a small sandbox top-up so you don’t exhaust test tokens while validating the change?

What we propose:
- 14-day pilot extension (same terms)
- +100k token sandbox top-up (no charge)
- A short joint triage session with our infra engineer to get past the SSO race condition

I’ve attached the integration log excerpt and a draft mutual action plan that outlines owners and milestones to get this over the finish line. If you confirm, I’ll loop in David for the technical call and Ben for the commercial note.

Appreciate the partnership here — want to make sure the momentum from your product team is preserved.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0163

Attachments: integration-log.txt (text), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Elliot Granger <elliot@novasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.m@novasys.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot runway extension due to integration backlog (Novasys)

Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up and for the clear actions.

We hit a couple more surprises in our staging cluster after the latest deploy: a race condition when a webhook retries and a SAML attribute mapping mismatch. Those two items are blocking our automated QA suite. Our dev lead estimates 7–10 business days to resolve, plus another 2–3 days for validation.

We’re aligned on the triage session — Priya will coordinate a time with David. We’d really appreciate the 14-day runway and the sandbox tokens while we validate. Can you confirm the extension and token top-up in writing?

—Elliot
Elliot Granger
Head of Platform Engineering, Novasys
elliot@novasys.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Pilot runway extension due to integration backlog (Novasys)

Ben / David — forwarding Novasys' note. They have a legitimate staging blocker that will push validation ~two weeks.

Ben: can we approve a 14-day extension and a 100k token sandbox top-up (comp) for this pilot? Novasys is a mid-market account with clear expansion potential; preserving the demo schedule keeps the opportunity warm.

David: engineered ask — are you available for a 30-min triage tomorrow (Fri 10am PT) to review the webhook retry pattern and SAML mapping? I’ve attached the integration log excerpt and a screen grab of the mapping error.

If you want a quick summary for finance — Novasys deal D-4892, mid-market AE-led. I’ll track approvals and send an update to Elliot when we have sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa
